selfTest.title: Security self-test
selfTest.intro: Checks, on the real cloud, that one account can't see or change another account's data. You need two test accounts: A and B. Only a test row is used; your trackers are not touched.
selfTest.step1: 1. As account A: create a test row
selfTest.step3: 3. As account B: try to read, change and delete it
selfTest.step4: 4. As account A again: check and clean up
selfTest.created: Created a test row as account A. Next: step 2, and sign in as account B.
selfTest.alreadyCreated: A test row already exists. Go on with the next step, or clean it up as account A first.
selfTest.noTest: There's no test row yet. Start with step 1 as account A.
selfTest.needB: You're signed in as account A. Switch to account B first (step 2).
selfTest.needA: Sign in as account A, the one that created the test row, to clean up.
selfTest.pass: PASS. Account B couldn't read, change or delete account A's row. Next: switch back to account A and clean up.
selfTest.fail: FAIL. Account B could reach account A's row. Don't use real data until this is fixed.
selfTest.incomplete: Not finished: a check couldn't run. Check the internet connection and try step 3 again.
selfTest.unchanged: The test row was still there and unchanged. It's now deleted. All done.
selfTest.changed: FAIL. The test row had been changed by another account. It's now deleted.
selfTest.missing: FAIL. The test row was gone, so another account could delete it.
selfTest.failed: That step didn't work. Check the internet connection and try again.
